is Ingredient In

Property

The sub-relation of loze:isComponentIn that obtains whenever the component is a substance that occurres in the composite in a given amount

For example

In the case of a cake having as ingredient 200 grams of wheat flour, wheat flour is the ingredient; in the case of a solution having as ingredient 2 litres of water, water is the ingredient

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.

isParticipantInEntity → Eventuality
isComponentInParticular → Compositionnarrows domain and range
isIngredientInSubstance → Compositionnarrows domain
Note

Substance repetition is impractical to account for in terms of number of occurrences, since the units are too many to be counted; consequently, instead of using loze:hasNumberOfOccurrences, it is advisable to specify quantities based on units of measure

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
